Class GenerateCSVFiles

java.lang.Object
GenerateCSVFiles
public class GenerateCSVFiles extends Object
The GenerateCSVFiles class is responsible for generating output CSV files containing orbit status and collision risk assessments for space objects.

It reads input CSV data, parses and processes it using the SpaceObject and Assessment classes, then writes the augmented results to a specified output file.

Output types supported:

  • Orbit - Adds columns for orbit likelihood and recommended action
  • Collision - Adds columns for collision risk and recommended action
  • Tracking - Adds both orbit and collision analysis results

    • generateCSV

      public static void generateCSV(String inputFilePath, String outputFilePath, String type)
      Generates a new CSV file with additional data for orbit or collision risk assessments based on the provided type.
      Parameters:
      inputFilePath - Path to the input CSV file containing space object data.
      outputFilePath - Path to the output CSV file to be created.
      type - Type of data to generate: "Orbit", "Collision", or "Tracking".
